events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Never use image generation tools or models. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

input.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Ramen</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:#07050400;background:#070504;overflow:hidden}
canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;cursor:default}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen" role="img"></canvas>
<script>
(()=>{
const cv=document.getElementById('c'),g=cv.getContext('2d');
const reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
let W,H,dpr,R,cx,cy,D;
function rng(s){return()=>{s|=0;s=s+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}
const rand=rng(7);
const M={x:0,y:0,tx:0,ty:0,px:0,py:0,vx:0,vy:0,active:false,sx:0,sy:0};

function resize(){
  dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;
  cv.width=W*dpr;cv.height=H*dpr;
  R=Math.min(W*0.4,H*0.5*1.05);
  if(W<H)R=Math.min(W*0.44,H*0.4);
  cx=W/2;cy=H*0.56;D=R*0.62;
  if(reduce.matches)frame(0);
}
addEventListener('resize',resize);
addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  M.tx=(e.clientX/W-.5)*2;M.ty=(e.clientY/H-.5)*2;
  M.sx=e.clientX;M.sy=e.clientY;M.active=true;
  M.vx+=e.movementX||0;M.vy+=e.movementY||0;
});
addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{M.active=false;M.tx=0;M.ty=0});

// ---- scene data
const strands=[];
for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
  strands.push({u:rand()*1.5-.75,v:rand()*1.3-.65,a:rand()*Math.PI*2,len:.5+rand()*.7,
    amp:.05+rand()*.08,fr:3+rand()*4,ph:rand()*6.28,sp:.3+rand()*.5,w:.028+rand()*.01,tone:rand()});
}
const oil=[];
for(let i=0;i<34;i++){const a=rand()*6.28,r=Math.sqrt(rand())*.85;oil.push({u:Math.cos(a)*r,v:Math.sin(a)*r,r:.012+rand()*.035,ph:rand()*6})}
const seeds=[];
for(let i=0;i<70;i++){const a=rand()*6.28,r=Math.sqrt(rand())*.8;seeds.push({u:Math.cos(a)*r,v:Math.sin(a)*r,a:rand()*3})}
const tops=[
 {k:'mush',u:-.42,v:-.28,s:.2,a:.4,d:1},
 {k:'tofu',u:.25,v:-.3,s:.2,a:.35,d:1.2},
 {k:'bok',u:-.02,v:.02,s:.27,a:-.25,d:1.4},
 {k:'corn',u:.55,v:.12,s:.14,a:0,d:1.1},
 {k:'tofu',u:-.5,v:.2,s:.19,a:-.5,d:1.2},
 {k:'mush',u:.32,v:.42,s:.19,a:-.3,d:1},
 {k:'scal',u:-.15,v:.5,s:.1,a:0,d:1},
 {k:'scal',u:.62,v:-.1,s:.08,a:0,d:1},
 {k:'scal',u:-.68,v:-.02,s:.08,a:0,d:1},
];

// ---- steam
const sprite=document.createElement('canvas');sprite.width=sprite.height=64;
{const s=sprite.getContext('2d'),gr=s.createRadialGradient(32,32,0,32,32,32);
 gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,238,215,1)');gr.addColorStop(.4,'rgba(255,228,200,.45)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,220,190,0)');
 s.fillStyle=gr;s.fillRect(0,0,64,64)}
const steam=[];
function spawn(pre){
  const a=rand()*6.28,r=Math.sqrt(rand())*.7;
  steam.push({x:cx+Math.cos(a)*r*R*.9,y:cy+Math.sin(a)*r*R*.35-R*.05,vx:0,vy:-(18+rand()*22),
    age:pre?rand()*7:0,life:5+rand()*3,size:R*(.06+rand()*.06),ph:rand()*100,sd:.5+rand()});
}
function updSteam(dt,t){
  const want=reduce.matches?60:110;
  while(steam.length<want)spawn(steam.length<want&&t===0);
  for(let i=steam.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const p=steam[i];p.age+=dt;
    if(p.age>p.life){steam.splice(i,1);continue}
    const k=p.age/p.life;
    p.vx+=(Math.sin(t*.6+p.ph+p.y*.01)*14*p.sd-p.vx*.4)*dt+(M.px*40)*dt;
    if(M.active){
      const dx=p.x-M.sx,dy=p.y-M.sy,d2=dx*dx+dy*dy,rr=R*.45;
      if(d2<rr*rr){const d=Math.sqrt(d2)+1,f=(1-d/rr);p.vx+=dx/d*f*260*dt+M.vx*.5*f;p.vy+=dy/d*f*120*dt+M.vy*.3*f}
    }
    p.vy+=(-(28+k*22)-p.vy)*dt*.8;
    p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.size+=R*.045*dt;
  }
}
function drawSteam(){
  g.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  for(const p of steam){
    const k=p.age/p.life,a=Math.sin(Math.PI*Math.min(1,k))*.09*(1-k*.4);
    g.globalAlpha=a;const s=p.size*2;
    g.drawImage(sprite,p.x-s/2,p.y-s/2,s,s);
  }
  g.globalAlpha=1;g.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
}

// ---- helpers
function ell(x,y,rx,ry){g.beginPath();g.ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,0,0,6.2832)}
function rrect(x,y,w,h,r){g.beginPath();g.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r)}

function drawBackground(t){
  g.fillStyle='#070504';g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const fl=1+Math.sin(t*2.1)*.03+Math.sin(t*5.3)*.015;
  let gr=g.createRadialGradient(cx+M.x*R*.1,cy-R*.1,0,cx,cy,R*2.4);
  gr.addColorStop(0,`rgba(190,90,30,${.34*fl})`);
  gr.addColorStop(.35,`rgba(120,45,15,${.16*fl})`);
  gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(7,5,4,0)');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // table plane
  gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,cy+D*.5,0,H);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(40,20,10,.0)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(20,10,6,.7)');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,cy+D*.5,W,H);
}

function drawBowl(t,ox,oy){
  const x=cx+ox,y=cy+oy;
  // shadow
  g.save();
  let gr=g.createRadialGradient(x,y+D*1.02,0,x,y+D*1.02,R*1.25);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,.75)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.translate(0,0);g.scale(1,1);
  ell(x,y+D*1.02,R*1.25,R*.3);g.fill();g.restore();
  // warm bounce light on table
  gr=g.createRadialGradient(x,y+D*1.02,0,x,y+D*1.02,R*1.1);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(220,110,40,.18)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(220,110,40,0)');
  g.fillStyle=gr;ell(x,y+D*1.02,R*1.1,R*.28);g.fill();
  // foot
  g.fillStyle='#1a0f0b';rrect(x-R*.36,y+D*.93,R*.72,D*.1,6);g.fill();
  // body
  g.beginPath();
  g.moveTo(x-R,y);
  g.bezierCurveTo(x-R*.98,y+D*.75,x-R*.6,y+D*.98,x-R*.36,y+D*.98);
  g.lineTo(x+R*.36,y+D*.98);
  g.bezierCurveTo(x+R*.6,y+D*.98,x+R*.98,y+D*.75,x+R,y);
  g.closePath();
  gr=g.createLinearGradient(x-R,0,x+R,0);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'#1d1210');gr.addColorStop(.3,'#3a1d14');gr.addColorStop(.55,'#2a1610');gr.addColorStop(1,'#0e0807');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fill();
  // glaze band
  g.save();g.clip();
  gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+D);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');gr.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(0,0,0,.25)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.6)');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(x-R,y,R*2,D);
  // warm rim light from broth glow
  gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+D*.5);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,140,60,.28)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,140,60,0)');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(x-R,y,R*2,D*.5);
  // decorative band
  g.strokeStyle='rgba(200,150,90,.22)';g.lineWidth=R*.012;
  g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x-R*.97,y+D*.28);g.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+D*.5,x+R*.97,y+D*.28);g.stroke();
  g.strokeStyle='rgba(200,150,90,.12)';g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x-R*.93,y+D*.36);g.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+D*.58,x+R*.93,y+D*.36);g.stroke();
  // specular streak following mouse
  const sx=x+M.x*R*.5-R*.45;
  gr=g.createLinearGradient(sx-R*.12,0,sx+R*.12,0);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,220,180,0)');gr.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(255,220,180,.13)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,220,180,0)');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(sx-R*.12,y,R*.24,D);
  g.restore();
  // rim
  ell(x,y,R,R*.42);
  gr=g.createLinearGradient(x-R,0,x+R,0);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'#5a3626');gr.addColorStop(.5,'#8a5a3e');gr.addColorStop(1,'#3a2018');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fill();
  ell(x,y-R*.01,R*.955,R*.395);g.fillStyle='#160b08';g.fill();
}

function drawBroth(t,ox,oy){
  const x=cx+ox,y=cy+oy,rx=R*.93,ry=R*.385;
  g.save();
  ell(x,y,rx,ry);g.clip();
  let gr=g.createRadialGradient(x+M.x*rx*.2,y-ry*.2,0,x,y,rx);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'#e0902f');gr.addColorStop(.6,'#b8611c');gr.addColorStop(1,'#6a2c0e');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(x-rx,y-ry,rx*2,ry*2);
  // ripples
  g.lineWidth=R*.006;
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const k=((t*.12+i/5)%1);
    g.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,200,120,${.16*(1-k)})`;
    ell(x+Math.sin(i*2)*rx*.3,y+Math.cos(i*3)*ry*.3,rx*.15+k*rx*.7,ry*.15+k*ry*.7);g.stroke();
  }
  // noodles
  for(const s of strands){
    const ang=s.a+Math.sin(t*s.sp+s.ph)*.05;
    g.beginPath();
    const n=28;
    for(let j=0;j<=n;j++){
      const f=j/n-.5,l=f*s.len;
      const px=s.u+Math.cos(ang)*l+Math.cos(ang+1.57)*Math.sin(f*s.fr*3+s.ph+t*s.sp)*s.amp;
      const py=s.v+Math.sin(ang)*l+Math.sin(ang+1.57)*Math.sin(f*s.fr*3+s.ph+t*s.sp)*s.amp;
      j?g.lineTo(x+px*rx,y+py*ry):g.moveTo(x+px*rx,y+py*ry);
    }
    g.lineCap='round';g.lineJoin='round';
    g.strokeStyle='rgba(90,40,10,.55)';g.lineWidth=s.w*rx*1.5;g.stroke();
    g.strokeStyle=s.tone>.5?'#e9c27a':'#dcae5f';g.lineWidth=s.w*rx;g.stroke();
    g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,240,200,.35)';g.lineWidth=s.w*rx*.35;g.stroke();
  }
  g.restore();
}

function drawTop(p,t,ox,oy){
  const rx=R*.93,ry=R*.385;
  const bob=Math.sin(t*.8+p.u*7+p.v*5)*R*.006;
  const x=cx+ox*p.d+p.u*rx,y=cy+oy*p.d+p.v*ry+bob,s=p.s*R;
  g.save();g.translate(x,y);g.rotate(p.a+Math.sin(t*.5+p.u*4)*.02);g.scale(1,.72);
  // contact shadow
  g.fillStyle='rgba(60,20,0,.4)';ell(s*.05,s*.12,s*.75,s*.55);g.fill();
  if(p.k==='tofu'){
    let gr=g.createLinearGradient(-s,-s,s,s);gr.addColorStop(0,'#f5e6c4');gr.addColorStop(1,'#d9b877');
    g.fillStyle='#b48644';rrect(-s*.7,-s*.55+s*.16,s*1.4,s*1.1,s*.14);g.fill();
    g.fillStyle=gr;rrect(-s*.7,-s*.6,s*1.4,s*1.1,s*.16);g.fill();
    g.strokeStyle='rgba(150,95,35,.6)';g.lineWidth=s*.09;rrect(-s*.68,-s*.58,s*1.36,s*1.06,s*.16);g.stroke();
    g.fillStyle='rgba(120,70,20,.35)';for(let i=0;i<5;i++){ell(Math.sin(i*5)*s*.4,Math.cos(i*3)*s*.3,s*.05,s*.04);g.fill()}
  }else if(p.k==='mush'){
    let gr=g.createRadialGradient(-s*.2,-s*.2,0,0,0,s);gr.addColorStop(0,'#a87a52');gr.addColorStop(.7,'#5a3620');gr.addColorStop(1,'#2e1a0e');
    g.fillStyle='#2a170c';ell(0,s*.15,s,s*.9);g.fill();
    g.fillStyle=gr;ell(0,0,s,s*.95);g.fill();
    g.strokeStyle='rgba(235,215,180,.75)';g.lineWidth=s*.09;g.lineCap='round';
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(0,0);const a=i*2.09+.4;g.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*s*.6,Math.sin(a)*s*.55);g.stroke()}
    g.fillStyle='rgba(255,220,170,.3)';ell(-s*.3,-s*.35,s*.3,s*.14);g.fill();
  }else if(p.k==='bok'){
    for(let i=-2;i<=2;i++){
      g.save();g.rotate(i*.42);
      let gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,s*.4,0,-s*1.1);gr.addColorStop(0,'#c8e6a0');gr.addColorStop(.35,'#6fb04a');gr.addColorStop(1,'#2f7a2c');
      g.fillStyle=gr;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(-s*.12,s*.5);g.bezierCurveTo(-s*.75,-s*.1,-s*.5,-s*1.1,0,-s*1.1);
      g.bezierCurveTo(s*.5,-s*1.1,s*.75,-s*.1,s*.12,s*.5);g.closePath();g.fill();
      g.strokeStyle='rgba(220,245,190,.6)';g.lineWidth=s*.06;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(0,s*.45);g.lineTo(0,-s*.8);g.stroke();
      g.restore();
    }
  }else if(p.k==='corn'){
    for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
      const a=i*2.4,r=Math.sqrt(i/16)*s;
      const kx=Math.cos(a)*r,ky=Math.sin(a)*r*.8;
      g.fillStyle='#e0a010';ell(kx,ky+s*.05,s*.2,s*.17);g.fill();
      g.fillStyle='#ffd84a';ell(kx,ky,s*.19,s*.16);g.fill();
      g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,220,.7)';ell(kx-s*.05,ky-s*.05,s*.05,s*.04);g.fill();
    }
  }else if(p.k==='scal'){
    for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
      const a=i*2.7,r=(i/7)*s*3;
      const kx=Math.cos(a)*r,ky=Math.sin(a)*r*.6;
      g.fillStyle='#3d8a2c';ell(kx,ky,s*.8,s*.7);g.fill();
      g.fillStyle='#c9e8a0';ell(kx,ky,s*.5,s*.4);g.fill();
      g.fillStyle='#e8f5c8';ell(kx,ky,s*.2,s*.15);g.fill();
    }
  }
  g.restore();
}

function drawNori(t,ox,oy){
  const x=cx+ox*1.6+R*.5,y=cy+oy*1.6-R*.02,w=R*.34,h=R*.5;
  g.save();g.translate(x,y);g.rotate(.22+Math.sin(t*.6)*.008);
  let gr=g.createLinearGradient(-w/2,0,w/2,0);gr.addColorStop(0,'#0e1a12');gr.addColorStop(.5,'#1e3a28');gr.addColorStop(1,'#0a120c');
  g.fillStyle='rgba(30,10,0,.5)';ell(0,0,w*.6,R*.04);g.fill();
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(-w/2,0);g.lineTo(-w/2-2,-h*.5);g.lineTo(-w/2+w*.08,-h);g.lineTo(w/2,-h*.98);g.lineTo(w/2+2,0);g.closePath();g.fill();
  g.strokeStyle='rgba(120,190,150,.18)';g.lineWidth=1.2;
  for(let i=1;i<9;i++){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(-w/2,-h*i/9);g.lineTo(w/2,-h*i/9+Math.sin(i)*2);g.stroke()}
  g.restore();
}

function drawOilAndSeeds(t,ox,oy){
  const rx=R*.93,ry=R*.385;
  for(const o of oil){
    const x=cx+ox*.6+o.u*rx,y=cy+oy*.6+o.v*ry,r=o.r*R*(1+Math.sin(t*.7+o.ph)*.05);
    g.fillStyle='rgba(210,70,10,.5)';ell(x,y,r,r*.5);g.fill();
    g.fillStyle='rgba(255,170,80,.4)';ell(x-r*.3,y-r*.15,r*.35,r*.15);g.fill();
  }
  g.fillStyle='#f3e6c8';
  for(const s of seeds){
    const x=cx+ox*1.1+s.u*rx,y=cy+oy*1.1+s.v*ry;
    g.save();g.translate(x,y);g.rotate(s.a);ell(0,0,R*.008,R*.004);g.fill();g.restore();
  }
}

function drawSheen(t,ox,oy){
  const x=cx+ox,y=cy+oy,rx=R*.93,ry=R*.385;
  g.save();ell(x,y,rx,ry);g.clip();
  const hx=x-M.x*rx*.35,hy=y-ry*.35-M.y*ry*.2;
  let gr=g.createRadialGradient(hx,hy,0,hx,hy,rx*.5);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,225,170,.28)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,225,170,0)');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(x-rx,y-ry,rx*2,ry*2);
  // inner wall shadow
  gr=g.createRadialGradient(x,y+ry*.1,rx*.6,x,y,rx*1.02);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(20,6,0,0)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(20,6,0,.6)');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(x-rx,y-ry,rx*2,ry*2);
  // back wall shading
  gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,y-ry,0,y-ry*.4);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(10,3,0,.55)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(10,3,0,0)');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(x-rx,y-ry,rx*2,ry);
  g.restore();
}

let last=performance.now(),T=0;
function frame(dt){
  const still=reduce.matches;
  if(!still){
    M.x+=(M.tx-M.x)*Math.min(1,dt*3);M.y+=(M.ty-M.y)*Math.min(1,dt*3);
    M.px+=(M.x-M.px)*Math.min(1,dt*.8);
    M.vx*=Math.pow(.02,dt);M.vy*=Math.pow(.02,dt);
  }
  const t=still?3:T;
  const ox=-M.x*R*.03,oy=-M.y*R*.015;
  drawBackground(t);
  drawBowl(t,ox,oy);
  drawBroth(t,ox,oy);
  drawSheen(t,ox,oy);
  const sorted=[...tops].sort((a,b)=>a.v-b.v);
  g.save();
  const rx=R*.93,ry=R*.385;
  g.beginPath();g.ellipse(cx+ox,cy+oy,rx*1.0,ry*1.0+R*.15,0,0,6.2832);g.clip();
  const tx=ox*-.5,ty=oy*-.5;
  for(const p of sorted)drawTop(p,t,tx,ty);
  g.restore();
  drawOilAndSeeds(t,tx,ty);
  drawNori(t,tx,ty);
  updSteam(still?0.0001:dt,still?0:T);
  drawSteam();
  // vignette
  const gr=g.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,R*.8,cx,cy,Math.max(W,H)*.75);
  gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.75)');
  g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
}

function loop(now){
  if(reduce.matches){return}
  const dt=Math.min(.05,(now-last)/1000);last=now;T+=dt;
  g.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  frame(dt);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reduce.addEventListener('change',()=>{last=performance.now();resize();if(!reduce.matches)requestAnimationFrame(loop)});
resize();
g.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
for(let i=0;i<110;i++)spawn(true);
if(reduce.matches){g.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);frame(0)}else requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

I wrote `index.html` in the working directory. It's a single file with inline CSS and JS, no external assets. I haven't opened it in a browser, so none of it has been run or checked visually.

It draws a canvas scene of a dark ceramic bowl of ramen, lit by a warm flickering glow. In the broth are wavy noodles, tofu, shiitake, bok choy, corn, scallions, sesame seeds, chili oil droplets and a standing nori sheet. Steam rises from the bowl.

The mouse shifts the parallax and moves the broth and bowl highlights. It also pushes the steam around.

There is no text or UI. The canvas resizes to any screen. With `prefers-reduced-motion`, it draws one still frame instead of animating.

You pasted a Python harness alongside the task. I didn't run it, since I was only asked to create the page.

excluded: large base64 and embedded image data (event retained with size marker)
